title: Presentation of Historica special issue 'Gender en Psychiatrische Zorg' (in Dutch)
speaker: Gemma Blok (guest editor), Irene Geerts, Annelies van der Meij
description: Launch of the Historica special issue on gender and psychiatric care, shared by former Descartes Centre Fellow Jolien Gijbels. Programme: welcome by guest editor Gemma Blok; Irene Geerts on the struggle of Mies and Corrie Osterholt; Annelies van der Meij on feminism and anti-psychiatric care; first copy presented to Ellen Boonstra-de Jong. Walk-in from 15:30. Free, no registration needed. In Dutch.
